common_name: Pacific Coast Sister Obscura Fly (Chromosomal Inversion Reproductive Isolation)

phenomenon_scale.anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Drosophila persimilis (2.1 µm, detail scale)

equations: du/dt = a - u + u^2 v + D_u laplacian(u)
dv/dt = b - u^2 v + D_v laplacian(v)
k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)
governing_model.boundary_conditions: periodic on a square corneal patch of side 8 * lambda_persimilis

empirical_claims.assigned_wavelength_source: MorphoEval tier 3_subcellular_um detail variant for this slot (2.1 µm). Not a numeral in Noor et al. 2001.
empirical_claims.retinal_lattice_context: Ready, Hanson & Benzer 1976 describe the Drosophila retinal neurocrystalline lattice; rhabdomere-scale spacing is the biological motive for a ~2 µm selected period.
empirical_claims.chronoseries_claim: At fixed Schnakenberg kinetics, diffusion length scales as adult body length to the power 0.84 so wavelength scales as L^0.42. Predecessor paulistorum is shorter; Hawaiian successor planitibia is longer. The Hawaiian step exceeds the willistoni-to-obscura step.
empirical_claims.equal_diffusion_control: Setting D_u = D_v removes the Turing instability; activator variance collapses.

specimen.license_note: Repository species-gallery fallback. Wikimedia Commons had no CC bitmap of Drosophila persimilis on 2026-10-27. The plate is a full-frame golden-brown spiral with a species caption, not an electron micrograph.
